end.summary:
Practised what common animals eat and identified deer as eating grass.
Built and read food chains using arrows, including grass → deer and mango leaf → caterpillar.
Explained that arrows show food moving to the eater.
Predicted that fish would have no food if an earlier link was removed.
Said dead leaves would break down slowly.
end.parentNote: Manav practised plant-eaters and simple food chains. They used the food source first, then the eater, and correctly explained the arrow direction in several chains. They also correctly predicted what would happen to fish when an earlier food source was removed; no mix-up was recorded. At home, ask them to make one food chain with three living things and explain each arrow.
